scripts.build:native: clang++ -shared -fPIC -O2 -fobjc-arc -Wno-deprecated-declarations -framework Foundation -framework ImageIO -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework CoreMedia -o resources/native/libkarttapallo.dylib resources/native/karttapallo-bridge.mm
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && bun run --hot src/server/dev.ts
scripts.dev:app: bun run build:native && electrobun build && electrobun dev
scripts.build:app:stable: bun run build:native && ELECTROBUN_DEVELOPER_ID=${ELECTROBUN_DEVELOPER_ID:-Karttapallo Signing} electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.install:app: bun run build:app:stable && bash scripts/finalize-stable.sh && rm -rf /Applications/Karttapallo.app && cp -r build/stable-macos-arm64/Karttapallo.app /Applications/ && /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister -f /Applications/Karttapallo.app
